 Police arrest man, 23, for alleged kidnapping in Waikiki
 By Star-Advertiser staff
 Today 
 • 
 Last updated
 2:22 p.m. 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X 
 Share by email 
 -->
 Honolulu police arrested a 23-year-old man Monday for the alleged kidnapping of a woman in Waikiki.
 Police said the man grabbed a 24-year-old woman shortly after noon in Waikiki and tried to carry her to his vehicle. The woman, who was accompanied by a 77-year-old woman, managed to break free before the suspect fled the scene in his car.
 Officers located the suspect shortly after 2:30 p.m., identified him and took him into custody without incident.
 The suspect remains in custody pending further investigation. Police did not release additional details.
